sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是Benjamin Poulin，我是Mark Ronson，欢迎收听《重塑者》（The Reframers），这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在黑胶唱片时代的夜店里做DJ的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去上班，把DJ台变成一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《重塑者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的Michael Bavaro。

sentences.en: This is A Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》（The Daily）。

sentences.en: A series of closely watched primary elections starting today in Ohio will be the first big test of Donald Trump's hold on the Republican Party since he lost re-election.
sentences.zh: 从今天开始在俄亥俄州举行的一系列备受关注的初选，将是唐纳德·特朗普自竞选连任失败以来，对他在共和党内掌控力的一次重大考验。

sentences.en: My colleague, Shane Goldmacher, has been tracking Trump's midterm endorsements and the extraordinary lengths that candidates have gone to win them.
sentences.zh: 我的同事Shane Goldmacher一直在追踪特朗普对中期选举的背书情况，以及候选人们为了获得这些背书所付出的非凡努力。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, May 3rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月3日，星期二。

sentences.en: Shane, what exactly is former President Trump's role in the 2022 midterm elections, these Republican primary races that really start in earnest this week?
sentences.zh: Shane，特朗普前总统在2022年中期选举中，也就是本周正式拉开帷幕的这些共和党初选中，究竟扮演着什么角色？

sentences.en: Well, what I found is that what Trump is doing is just frankly unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我发现特朗普的做法坦率地说前所未有。

sentences.en: He lost the 2020 election and instead of exiting the political stage, he's very much remained in the middle of it.
sentences.zh: 他输掉了2020年大选，但并没有退出政治舞台，而是依然稳居舞台中央。

sentences.en: And you think of old past presidents and they really don't play a big role immediately after their presidency in trying to shape the politics of their party.
sentences.zh: 想想过去的前总统们，他们在卸任后通常不会立即在塑造本党政治方面扮演重要角色。

sentences.en: You know, Barack Obama was not trying to reshape the Democratic Party in his image after his two terms in the White House.
sentences.zh: 你知道，巴拉克·奥巴马在白宫任职两届后，并没有试图以自己的形象重塑民主党。

sentences.en: He kind of let the party fight over what it was going to be without his involvement.
sentences.zh: 他基本上让党内自行争论未来的走向，而没有过多干预。

sentences.en: Trump is not doing that.
sentences.zh: 特朗普却不是这样。

sentences.en: Trump is continuing to raise more money than the party itself.
sentences.zh: 特朗普筹集的资金仍在持续超过共和党本身。

sentences.en: He's sitting on more than $120 million.
sentences.zh: 他手里握着超过1.2亿美元的资金。

sentences.en: In the last six months of 2021, he outraged the Republican National Committee itself every single day but two.
sentences.zh: 在2021年的最后六个月里，除了两天之外，他每天都在筹款额上压过共和党全国委员会一头。

sentences.en: That's astonishing.
sentences.zh: 这太惊人了。

sentences.en: So he's pulling in more money than the party.
sentences.zh: 所以他筹集的资金比党内还要多。

sentences.en: He is pulling in candidates to talk to him, to shape what they stand for.
sentences.zh: 他正在吸引候选人与他交谈，以塑造他们的政治立场。

sentences.en: And the tool that he's using to most shape the party is his endorsement.
sentences.zh: 而他用来塑造政党的最主要工具就是他的背书。

sentences.en: He's offering it to tons of candidates and races across the country in governor's races and Senate races and congressional races and secretary of state races and state attorney general races and even state legislative races.
sentences.zh: 他向全国各地的无数候选人和竞选活动提供背书，包括州长竞选、参议院竞选、国会竞选、州务卿竞选、州总检察长竞选，甚至州议会竞选。

sentences.en: And Shane, why are endorsements, which are pretty old school, why is that his most powerful tool right now?
sentences.zh: Shane，为什么背书这种相当老派的做法，现在成了他最强大的工具？

sentences.en: Well, it's not just a powerful tool.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这不仅仅是一个强大的工具。

sentences.en: It's a barometer that Trump himself has used to measure his political power.
sentences.zh: 这是特朗普本人用来衡量其政治权力的晴雨表。

sentences.en: It has just been stated that President Trump's endorsement is the most powerful asset in politics.
sentences.zh: 刚刚有人说，特朗普总统的背书是政界最强大的资产。

sentences.en: Do you believe that?
sentences.zh: 你相信吗？

sentences.en: So for years, he has said the fact that when he backs people in Republican primaries, they win.
sentences.zh: 多年来他一直说，事实就是当他在共和党初选中支持某人时，他们就会赢。

sentences.en: In last year's congressional primaries, 120.
sentences.zh: 在去年的国会初选中，是120个。

sentences.en: Listen to this.
sentences.zh: 听听这个。

sentences.en: It's crazy.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: 120 of 122 candidates.
sentences.zh: 122个候选人里中了120个。

sentences.en: I endorse one.
sentences.zh: 我背书了一个。

sentences.en: That that's the evidence of his power over the party because his power and his vantage comes from his voters, that the Trump electorate,
sentences.zh: 这就是他掌控共和党的证据，因为他的权力和优势来自于他的选民，也就是“特朗普选民群体”，

sentences.en: that's what's really powering the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 那才是真正推动共和党的力量。

sentences.en: And the two that lost were beaten by people claiming to be more Trump than their opponent.
sentences.zh: 而那两个输掉的候选人，是被那些声称比对手“更特朗普”的人击败的。

sentences.en: So I like those two people very much also.
sentences.zh: 所以我其实也很喜欢那两个人。

sentences.en: And so by endorsing all these people, he's putting his name on the ballot, too, in a way.
sentences.zh: 所以通过背书所有这些人，他在某种程度上也把自己的名字写在了选票上。

sentences.en: He's putting his reputation on the line and saying, if I can get these people over the line, I'm not just the most popular Republican in the country, which we know in polling,
sentences.zh: 他拿自己的声誉做赌注，并表示，如果我能让这些人胜出，我不仅是全国最受欢迎的共和党人——民调显示我们都知道这一点，

sentences.en: but the most powerful one.
sentences.zh: 而且还是最有权势的。

sentences.en: The person who can get his allies into office, so should he run for president again, and he's making every indication that he wants to do that,
sentences.zh: 他能把盟友送进政府，所以如果他再次竞选总统——而且他表现出了一切想要参选的迹象——

sentences.en: that he'll have people across the government already in place supporting him.
sentences.zh: 那么政府各部门里就已经有了支持他的人。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: So for Trump, endorsements aren't in any way just endorsements in the traditional sense.
sentences.zh: 所以对特朗普来说，背书在任何意义上都不只是传统意义上的背书。

sentences.en: They are a potential path for him back to power.
sentences.zh: 它们是他重返权力的潜在路径。

sentences.en: They're a ratification of his influence, and they are a network of Trump supporters who would help him, I guess, not just win, but govern if he wins?
sentences.zh: 它们是对他影响力的认可，也是一个特朗普支持者网络，我想，这不仅能帮他获胜，还能帮他在获胜后进行治理？

sentences.en: Govern if he wins,
sentences.zh: 获胜后进行治理，

sentences.en: and it's hard not to focus on the fact that one of the litmus tests he's made for his endorsements is amplifying and buying the falsehood that he didn't actually lose the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 而且不得不关注的一个事实是，他背书的试金石之一，就是放大并采信他并没有输掉2020年大选的谎言。

sentences.en: And in so many of these states, he's focused on the battlegrounds that he lost and replacing some of the same Republicans who certified the election.
sentences.zh: 在许多州，他专注于他输掉的战场，并替换掉了一些曾认证选举结果的共和党人。

sentences.en: And so it's not just about getting allies.
sentences.zh: 所以这不仅仅是为了寻找盟友。

sentences.en: It's getting people in key positions of power.
sentences.zh: 这是为了让这些人占据关键的权力职位。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So start to take us inside the machinery and the logistics of this Trump endorsement process for the 2022 midterMs.
sentences.zh: 那么，带我们深入了解一下2022年中期选举中，特朗普背书过程的运作机制和后勤工作吧。

sentences.en: Well, like all things Trump, there's a little bit of haphazardness to this, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，就像特朗普的所有事情一样，这其中有一点随意性，对吧？

sentences.en: But there have been efforts to make sort of a system in place, and really what it revolves around is, for much of the year, Mar-a-Lago, his private club in Florida.
sentences.zh: 但确实有人努力建立了一套系统，而这套系统的核心，在这一年的大部分时间里，就是海湖庄园（Mar-a-Lago），他在佛罗里达的私人俱乐部。

sentences.en: And he's working chiefly out of what was once the converted bridal suite at Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 他主要是在海湖庄园曾经的新娘套房改建的办公室里工作。

sentences.en: That's where he has his office.
sentences.zh: 那就是他的办公室所在的地方。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: He still has a big, big wooden desk, looks a lot like the kind of desk he once had in the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 他仍然有一张很大很大的木桌，看起来很像他曾经在椭圆形办公室用的那种桌子。

sentences.en: And he sits there and he brings candidates in, and he talks to them about the races.
sentences.zh: 他坐在那里，把候选人叫进来，和他们谈论竞选的事。

sentences.en: And look, there are certain questions he tends to ask.
sentences.zh: 听着，他倾向于问一些特定的问题。

sentences.en: How are you polling?
sentences.zh: 你的民调怎么样？

sentences.en: How is your fundraising?
sentences.zh: 你的筹款情况如何？

sentences.en: And do you think I actually won the 2020 presidential election?
sentences.zh: 你认为我真的赢得了2020年总统大选吗？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And so there's candidates who have started to have stock answers almost to these things.
sentences.zh: 所以有些候选人已经开始对这些问题准备了标准答案。

sentences.en: They bring printouts of their polls, and strategists have recommended bringing those printouts and having graphics and big fonts because that's how he consumes his information.
sentences.zh: 他们带着民调打印件来，策略师们建议他们带上这些打印件，并使用图表和大字体，因为这就是他获取信息的方式。

sentences.en: And in these meetings, you know, people make pitches both about themselves and about their opponents.
sentences.zh: 在这些会议中，人们既会推销自己，也会攻击对手。

sentences.en: Some of them bring sort of attack things that they think will resonate with him.
sentences.zh: 有些人会带上他们认为能引起他共鸣的攻击性材料。

sentences.en: Some of them bring extra pieces of their bio that they think that he'll appreciate and like.
sentences.zh: 有些人会带上他们简历中认为他会欣赏和喜欢的额外部分。

sentences.en: And look, I don't know that there's a better race that shows this process than the Pennsylvania Senate race.
sentences.zh: 听着，我不知道还有什么比宾夕法尼亚州的参议院竞选更能体现这个过程了。

sentences.en: So you have an open seat in Pennsylvania where a Republican incumbent has retired, and you had Trump make an early quick endorsement of that race of a candidate named Sean Parnell,
sentences.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州有一个空缺席位，因为一位共和党现任议员退休了，特朗普很早就迅速背书了一位名叫Sean Parnell的候选人，

sentences.en: who later dropped out because he was facing accusations of domestic violence.
sentences.zh: 但他后来因为面临家庭暴力的指控而退出了竞选。

sentences.en: And then when Parnell quit the race, two other candidates soon got in.
sentences.zh: Parnell退出后，很快又有两位候选人加入了竞选。

sentences.en: My parents came to America to find a better life.
sentences.zh: 我的父母来到美国是为了寻求更好的生活。

sentences.en: One is Dr. Mehmet Oz, the sort of longtime television personality and medical doctor.
sentences.zh: 一位是Mehmet Oz医生，他是长期活跃的电视名人和医学博士。

sentences.en: Pennsylvania needs a conservative who will put America firSt.
sentences.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州需要一位将美国放在首位的保守派。

sentences.en: And the second is David McCormick.
sentences.zh: 第二位是David McCormick。

sentences.en: I'm David McCormick.
sentences.zh: 我是David McCormick。

sentences.en: I'm sick of career politicians, too afraid to say what they're for and what they're againSt.
sentences.zh: 我也厌倦了那些不敢说出自己支持什么、反对什么的职业政客。

sentences.en: Who was the CEO of one of the world's largest hedge funds.
sentences.zh: 他曾是全球最大对冲基金之一的首席执行官。

sentences.en: I'm anti-woke, anti-illegal immigration, anti-political correctness, anti-socialism.
sentences.zh: 我反对“觉醒文化”，反对非法移民，反对政治正确，反对社会主义。

sentences.en: And even though these two candidates have their own resumes, they both went down to Mar-a-Lago and made their case directly to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 尽管这两位候选人都有各自的履历，但他们都去了海湖庄园，直接向唐纳德·特朗普陈述自己的理由。

sentences.en: And in fact, each of them spoke about the other one.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们每个人都谈到了对方。

sentences.en: So I was told that at his meeting, Dr. Oz brought along a clip of McCormick speaking negatively about Trump.
sentences.zh: 有人告诉我，在会面时，Oz医生带了一段McCormick负面评价特朗普的视频片段。

sentences.en: And in the McCormick meeting with Trump, both David McCormick and his wife are there.
sentences.zh: 而在McCormick与特朗普的会面中，David McCormick和他的妻子都在场。

sentences.en: And at one point, Dina Powell McCormick actually takes out a picture that shows Dr. Oz alongside other people who are wearing what appeared to be Muslim head coverings.
sentences.zh: 有一次，Dina Powell McCormick拿出一张照片，显示Oz医生和一些戴着看起来像是穆斯林头巾的人在一起。

sentences.en: And this is according to multiple people who were briefed on what happened at this meeting.
sentences.zh: 这是根据多位听取了会议情况简报的人士透露的。

sentences.en: And Dina Powell McCormick made the point that Dr. Oz is Muslim and that that has the potential to be a political liability in parts of Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: Dina Powell McCormick指出，Oz医生是穆斯林，这在宾夕法尼亚州的部分地区可能会成为政治包袱。

sentences.en: And I should say that the McCormick campaign has denied this interaction.
sentences.zh: 我应该说明，McCormick竞选团队否认了这次互动。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: But just to be sure I understand these series of visits with Trump, you have Dr. Oz showing Trump a video of McCormick dissing him.
sentences.zh: 但为了确保我理解这些与特朗普的会面，你是说Oz医生给特朗普看了一段McCormick贬低他的视频，

sentences.en: You have McCormick showing Trump a photo of Dr. Oz next to people wearing what looks like Muslim clothing.
sentences.zh: 而McCormick给特朗普看了一张Oz医生与戴着看起来像穆斯林服饰的人在一起的照片。

sentences.en: So these are two candidates using this precious time with the former president of the United States to basically try to knife each other, make each other unendorseable.
sentences.zh: 所以这两位候选人利用与美国前总统这宝贵的时间，基本上是在试图互相捅刀子，让对方失去被背书的资格。

sentences.en: And that's just one race.
sentences.zh: 而这仅仅是一场竞选。

sentences.en: Trump is endorsed in more than 100 races.
sentences.zh: 特朗普已经在100多场竞选中进行了背书。

sentences.en: And now not every single candidate has had an audience with him.
sentences.zh: 并不是每一位候选人都见过他。

sentences.en: But sometimes you have multiple candidates in a single race in the same meeting with Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 但有时你会看到同一场竞选中的多位候选人同时与唐纳德·特朗普会面。

sentences.en: So one of the biggest primaries that's going to test Trump's sway is the Ohio Senate race.
sentences.zh: 所以，考验特朗普影响力的最大初选之一是俄亥俄州的参议院竞选。

sentences.en: And there's a meeting that has become almost legend in Trump world that happened last year where you had multiple candidates in this Ohio Senate race,
sentences.zh: 去年发生了一次在特朗普圈子里几乎成为传奇的会议，当时俄亥俄州参议院竞选的多位候选人都在场，

sentences.en: the former state treasurer Josh Mandel, a former state party chair Jane Timken, a couple of businessmen Bernie Moreno and Mike Gibbons.
sentences.zh: 包括前州财务主管Josh Mandel、前州党主席Jane Timken，以及几位商人Bernie Moreno和Mike Gibbons。

sentences.en: And they're all down there and Trump sort of impromptu pulls them into a meeting and Politico first reported about this and they described it as the Hunger Games.
sentences.zh: 他们都在那里，特朗普即兴把他们叫进了一个会议室，《政客》（Politico）杂志率先报道了这件事，他们将其描述为“饥饿游戏”。

sentences.en: And it's really how people have talked about it.
sentences.zh: 人们确实是这样谈论它的。

sentences.en: And these multiple candidates started going after each other directly in front of Trump, making their case and undercutting each other in front of him.
sentences.zh: 这些候选人开始在特朗普面前直接攻击对方，陈述自己的理由，并当面拆对方的台。

sentences.en: And this is just like not something that happens in politics.
sentences.zh: 这在政治上是不可能发生的事情。

sentences.en: But for Trump, this actually is something that's happened for him before.
sentences.zh: 但对特朗普来说，这其实是他以前经历过的事情。

sentences.en: Right, because this is something that happens on The Apprentice.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为这正是《学徒》（The Apprentice）节目中发生的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah, this is him.
sentences.zh: 是的，这就是他。

sentences.en: He is the decider of fates.
sentences.zh: 他是命运的裁决者。

sentences.en: He has emerged not just as a political leader, but as something almost like an old school party boss at this point.
sentences.zh: 他不仅是一位政治领袖，此时此刻更像是一位老派的党魁。

sentences.en: This is one of his favorite roles.
sentences.zh: 这是他最喜欢的角色之一。

sentences.en: This is the raw exercise of power.
sentences.zh: 这是权力的赤裸裸行使。

sentences.en: And this endorsement idea that he gets to pick without even having to be on the ballot.
sentences.zh: 这种背书理念，即他无需出现在选票上就能进行挑选，

sentences.en: Who's a winner and who's a loser?
sentences.zh: 谁是赢家，谁是输家？

sentences.en: Who gets to move on to next week?
sentences.zh: 谁能进入下一轮？

sentences.en: Like, that's just classic Trump.
sentences.zh: 这简直就是典型的特朗普风格。

sentences.en: And it seems like the candidates here are very happy to, in a real way, perform for him and behave in a way that he wishes to see them behave in order to get that endorsement.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来这里的候选人非常乐意以一种真实的方式为他表演，并表现出他希望看到的样子，以便获得那份背书。

sentences.en: Even if that means, as in this case, slightly debasing themselves.
sentences.zh: 即使这意味着，就像这个案例一样，稍微贬低自己。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Now, there's a whole hierarchy of how people end up at Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 现在，人们进入海湖庄园有一套完整的等级制度。

sentences.en: There's people who get these formal sit-downs.
sentences.zh: 有些人能获得正式的会谈。

sentences.en: And then there are other candidates who pay big money to host a fundraiser at Mar-a-Lago, paying thousands, tens of thousands of dollars to hold their events there.
sentences.zh: 还有其他候选人花大钱在海湖庄园举办筹款活动，支付数千甚至数万美元在那里举行活动。

sentences.en: And sometimes Trump shows up.
sentences.zh: 有时特朗普会露面。

sentences.en: Sometimes he speaks at their fundraisers, even if he hasn't endorsed them yet.
sentences.zh: 有时他会在他们的筹款活动上发言，即使他还没有背书他们。

sentences.en: Sometimes holding an event at Mar-a-Lago is a way to get a meeting on the side with him.
sentences.zh: 有时在海湖庄园举办活动是获得与他私下会面的方式。

sentences.en: And then beyond that, you have sort of almost these hangers-on who are showing up at fundraisers that are at Mar-a-Lago where they're not the candidate,
sentences.zh: 除此之外，还有一些几乎是“蹭热度”的人出现在海湖庄园的筹款活动上，他们不是候选人，

sentences.en: but they're showing up at somebody else's event and maybe shouting at Trump and saying, hey, I'm running for Congress.
sentences.zh: 但他们出现在别人的活动上，可能会对着特朗普大喊：“嘿，我在竞选国会议员。”

sentences.en: I'm from North Carolina or Michigan.
sentences.zh: “我来自北卡罗来纳州或密歇根州。”

sentences.en: Shouting to Trump?
sentences.zh: 对着特朗普大喊？

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Like from the floor of a ballroom or something?
sentences.zh: 就像在宴会厅的地板上或者什么地方？

sentences.en: Yeah, so when there's a fundraiser, it's typically held just on the patio, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，所以当有筹款活动时，通常是在露台上举行，对吧？

sentences.en: The weather's good in Florida year-round.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达全年天气都很好。

sentences.en: And Trump typically comes out and he says a few words for these candidates, sometimes, again, even when he hasn't endorsed them, but usually when he has.
sentences.zh: 特朗普通常会出来为这些候选人说几句话，有时，再说一次，即使他还没有背书他们，但通常是在他已经背书的情况下。

sentences.en: And in the crowd will be people from lots of states across the country running for different offices.
sentences.zh: 人群中会有来自全国各地许多州、竞选不同职位的人。

sentences.en: I have this great honor tonight of introducing to you the greatest president in modern history.
sentences.zh: 今晚我很荣幸向大家介绍现代史上最伟大的总统。

sentences.en: So, Michael, let me give you one example of a recent fundraiser that Trump attended for another candidate in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 所以，Michael，让我给你举一个特朗普最近在密歇根州为另一位候选人参加的筹款活动的例子。

sentences.en: So, are there other people that are running for office right now, Misha, that are here that we haven't spotted?
sentences.zh: 那么，Misha，现在还有其他竞选公职的人在场，是我们还没发现的吗？

sentences.en: And he starts to invite the candidates in attendance up on the stage with him.
sentences.zh: 然后他开始邀请在场的候选人上台和他站在一起。

sentences.en: Come on up.
sentences.zh: 上来吧。

sentences.en: We have governor.
sentences.zh: 我们有州长。

sentences.en: Anybody else running?
sentences.zh: 还有其他人参选吗？

sentences.en: Perry's running.
sentences.zh: Perry在参选。

sentences.en: Come on up here, Perry.
sentences.zh: 上来吧，Perry。

sentences.en: And there's a voice from somebody who appears to be sort of blocked from getting up there.
sentences.zh: 这时传来一个声音，似乎是有人被挡住了，没能上去。

sentences.en: I'm running for governor, too.
sentences.zh: 我也在竞选州长。

sentences.en: And so, thank you, but you're running for governor of what?
sentences.zh: 所以，谢谢你，但你竞选的是哪里的州长？

sentences.en: Michigan.
sentences.zh: 密歇根州。

sentences.en: Can I come up?
sentences.zh: 我可以上来吗？

sentences.en: Come on up.
sentences.zh: 上来吧。

sentences.en: And so, Trump brings him up onto the stage.
sentences.zh: 于是，特朗普把他叫上了台。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And when he comes up, he shakes hands with another of his opponents who also is in the crowd.
sentences.zh: 当他走上来时，他与也在人群中的另一位对手握了手。

sentences.en: They'll end up in a fistfight.
sentences.zh: 他们最后会打起来的。

sentences.en: And then Trump, of course, goes to Michigan, holds a rally of his own, and mentions neither of these candidates.
sentences.zh: 然后特朗普当然去了密歇根州，自己举办了一场集会，却对这两位候选人只字未提。

sentences.en: He gives a shout-out to a third candidate who's also running for governor who had paid to hold a fundraiser of her own at Mar-a-Lago back in February.
sentences.zh: 他向另一位也在竞选州长的候选人表示了感谢，因为她二月份曾在海湖庄园自费举办了一场筹款活动。

sentences.en: So, because everything you're describing is so grounded in Mar-a-Lago, what chance do people have who don't or can't make it to Mar-a-Lago to get one of these endorsements?
sentences.zh: 那么，既然你所描述的一切都以海湖庄园为基础，那些无法或没能去海湖庄园的人，还有什么机会获得这些背书呢？

sentences.en: Well, one of the things we learned about Donald Trump from his time in the White House is that he watches lots of cable television.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们从唐纳德·特朗普在白宫任职期间了解到的一点是，他看很多有线电视。

sentences.en: And so, one of the ways that candidates, sometimes from thousands of miles away, will find their way in front of him is by buying television ads that air in Palm Beach.
sentences.zh: 所以，候选人有时即使远在千里之外，也能让他注意到自己的方式之一，就是在棕榈滩投放电视广告。

sentences.en: They geo-locate their ads to his part of Florida.
sentences.zh: 他们将广告进行地理定位，投放到他所在的佛罗里达州区域。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it's relatively cheap, right?
sentences.zh: 没错，而且相对便宜，对吧？

sentences.en: If you just want to buy ads on Fox News in Palm Beach, that's a potentially very efficient use of your campaign money if you can end up with Donald Trump's endorsement.
sentences.zh: 如果你只想在棕榈滩的福克斯新闻上投放广告，如果你最终能获得唐纳德·特朗普的背书，这可能是一种非常高效的竞选资金使用方式。

sentences.en: And so you had, you know, one woman...
sentences.zh: 所以你看到，你知道，有一位女士……

sentences.en: I'm Michelle Fiore, and I'm running for governor.
sentences.zh: 我是米歇尔·菲奥里，我正在竞选州长。

sentences.en: ...who rolled out this ad in Palm Beach, said she was going to run for governor of Nevada.
sentences.zh: ……她在棕榈滩投放了这则广告，说她要竞选内华达州州长。

sentences.en: I was the first female majority leader in Nevada Assembly and one of the first electeds to endorse Donald J.
sentences.zh: 我是内华达州议会第一位女性多数党领袖，也是最早支持唐纳德·J·特朗普的民选官员之一。

sentences.en: Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普。

sentences.en: And it made very clear that she was running as the pro-Trump candidate.
sentences.zh: 这非常明确地表明她是以亲特朗普候选人的身份参选的。

sentences.en: Washington Post called me a gun-toting calendar girl, and Politico Magazine said that I was the Lady Trump.
sentences.zh: 《华盛顿邮报》称我为“持枪挂历女郎”，而《政客》杂志则称我为“女版特朗普”。

sentences.en: And at the end of the ad, she actually pulls out a gun...
sentences.zh: 在广告结尾，她竟然掏出了一把枪……

sentences.en: ...and shoots several beer bottles, the last of which was labeled...
sentences.zh: ……射击了几个啤酒瓶，最后一个瓶子上贴着标签……

sentences.en: And stop voter fraud.
sentences.zh: 还有阻止选民欺诈。

sentences.en: ...voter fraud.
sentences.zh: ……选民欺诈。

sentences.en: I'm Michelle Fiore, and I'm ready for the fight.
sentences.zh: 我是米歇尔·菲奥里，我已经准备好战斗了。

sentences.en: And sometimes you can catch Trump in between the commercials, too, right?
sentences.zh: 有时你也可以在广告间隙抓住特朗普，对吧？

sentences.en: You can actually appear on the programs that he's watching.
sentences.zh: 你实际上可以出现在他正在看的节目中。

sentences.en: So the lieutenant governor of Idaho was on Tucker Carlson's program last year.
sentences.zh: 所以爱达荷州副州长去年上了塔克·卡尔森的节目。

sentences.en: And the next day, her phone rang, and it was Donald Trump saying, hey, great job on Tucker.
sentences.zh: 第二天，她的电话响了，是唐纳德·特朗普打来的，说，嘿，塔克的节目做得真棒。

sentences.en: And she dropped in, hey, you know what?
sentences.zh: 然后她顺势说，嘿，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I might be running for governor.
sentences.zh: 我可能要竞选州长了。

sentences.en: And so she jumped on a plane soon, met with him in New York.
sentences.zh: 于是她很快跳上飞机，在纽约见了他。

sentences.en: And a few months later, flew down to Mar-a-Lago to meet with him there.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，又飞往海湖庄园与他会面。

sentences.en: So what we're learning here is if you can't get a meeting with Donald Trump at Mar-a-Lago and you don't want to attend or can't afford to attend a fundraiser at Mar-a-Lago,
sentences.zh: 所以我们在这里了解到的是，如果你无法在海湖庄园与唐纳德·特朗普会面，也不想参加或负担不起在海湖庄园举办的筹款活动，

sentences.en: you can just cut a very hyper-local TV ad that runs near Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 你只需要制作一则在海湖庄园附近播放的超本地化电视广告即可。

sentences.en: Or you can work to land an interview on Fox News that might be watched by Trump at Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 或者你可以努力争取在福克斯新闻上接受采访，这可能会被在海湖庄园的特朗普看到。

sentences.en: That is how hungry and desperate all these candidates are for his endorsement right now.
sentences.zh: 这就是现在所有这些候选人对他的背书有多么渴望和绝望。

sentences.en: Yeah, and just like on The Apprentice, you've got way more candidates than you have winners in this process.
sentences.zh: 是的，就像在《学徒》节目中一样，在这个过程中，候选人远比赢家多。

sentences.en: And for both the winners and the losers, it often just remains a mystery as to why they actually ended up with his endorsement or without it.
sentences.zh: 对于赢家和输家来说，他们最终是否获得他的背书，往往仍然是一个谜。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日通讯《DealBook》的商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at The DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等等。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日通过NYTimes.com免费直播精选采访，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download The New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: So, Shane, who has been winning these endorsements?
sentences.zh: 那么，肖恩，谁一直在赢得这些背书呢？

sentences.en: And what are we learning as a result about which of these tactics that you have been describing are most effective and what kind of Republican Trump is leaning towards in this moment?
sentences.zh: 结果我们了解到，你所描述的这些策略中，哪些最有效？特朗普此刻倾向于哪种共和党人？

sentences.en: Well, let's start with one of the races we've already talked about, which is the Pennsylvania Senate race.
sentences.zh: 嗯，让我们从我们已经讨论过的竞选之一开始，即宾夕法尼亚州的参议院竞选。

sentences.en: And in that contest—
sentences.zh: 在那场竞争中——

sentences.en: By the way, I endorsed another person today, Dr. Oz in Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，我今天背书了另一个人，宾夕法尼亚州的奥兹医生。

sentences.en: Dr. Oz.
sentences.zh: 奥兹医生。

sentences.en: Trump has picked Dr. Mehmet Oz, who, in a lot of ways, is kind of a quintessential Trump endorsement pick.
sentences.zh: 特朗普选择了穆罕默德·奥兹医生，他在很多方面都是特朗普背书的典型人选。

sentences.en: Tremendous, tremendous career.
sentences.zh: 了不起，了不起的职业生涯。

sentences.en: And they liked him for a long time.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢他很久了。

sentences.en: That's like a poll.
sentences.zh: 那就像是一次民调。

sentences.en: You know, when you're in television for 18 years, that's like a poll.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你从事电视行业18年时，那就像是一次民调。

sentences.en: That means people like you, but he's a—
sentences.zh: 这意味着人们喜欢你，但他是一个——

sentences.en: And Trump, both in public and in private, for months has talked about the potential appeal of Dr. Oz because people voluntarily tuned in to watch him on television.
sentences.zh: 特朗普无论在公开场合还是私下里，几个月来一直都在谈论奥兹医生的潜在吸引力，因为人们是自愿收看他在电视上的节目的。

sentences.en: You know, Trump knows that power as a former television host himself.
sentences.zh: 你知道，作为一名前电视主持人，特朗普深知那种力量。

sentences.en: Now, if you lived in Pennsylvania and you were watching television—
sentences.zh: 现在，如果你住在宾夕法尼亚州，并且你在看电视——

sentences.en: Oz may be right for Hollywood, but he's wrong for Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 奥兹可能适合好莱坞，但他不适合宾夕法尼亚州。

sentences.en: The story about Dr. Oz you would see for the wave and wave of television attacks has been that he's a Hollywood liberal.
sentences.zh: 关于奥兹医生的故事，你会在一波又一波的电视攻击中看到，那就是他是一个好莱坞自由派。

sentences.en: They even have images of him kissing the Hollywood star.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至有他亲吻好莱坞明星的照片。

sentences.en: And they pull clips of him from his television show.
sentences.zh: 他们还从他的电视节目中剪辑片段。

sentences.en: Rhino Records presents Mehmet Oz's greatest hit.
sentences.zh: 犀牛唱片呈现：穆罕默德·奥兹的热门金曲。

sentences.en: You know, dancing with Michelle Obama.
sentences.zh: 你知道，和米歇尔·奥巴马跳舞。

sentences.en: And dancing the night away with liberal friends.
sentences.zh: 和自由派朋友彻夜跳舞。

sentences.en: And all these things raising real questions about his sort of, you know, conservative credentials.
sentences.zh: 所有这些事情都对他所谓的，你知道，保守派资历提出了真正的质疑。

sentences.en: Hollywood liberal Mehmet Oz's Republican and name-only hits just keep coming.
sentences.zh: 好莱坞自由派穆罕默德·奥兹的“名义共和党人”攻击不断。

sentences.en: And so by endorsing Oz, Trump is sort of saying, look, you might have seen these ads, but he's with me.
sentences.zh: 所以通过背书奥兹，特朗普实际上是在说，看，你可能看过这些广告，但他和我是一伙的。

sentences.en: And it has the potential to give him a real seal of approval, the Trump seal of approval, which is sure he might not have been perfect before, but look,
sentences.zh: 这有可能给他带来真正的认可印章，即“特朗普认可印章”，意思就是，当然他以前可能并不完美，但你看，

sentences.en: maybe I wasn't perfect before.
sentences.zh: 也许我以前也不完美。

sentences.en: Really interesting.
sentences.zh: 真有意思。

sentences.en: In Trump's statement on Oz, he did something that I found to be unusual, which he talked about Oz's electability.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普关于奥兹的声明中，他做了一件我认为不寻常的事情，那就是他谈到了奥兹的胜选能力。

sentences.en: He talked about him being able to beat the Democrats in the fall and even cited the fact that women were drawn to him through television.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了他有能力在秋季击败民主党人，甚至引用了女性通过电视被他吸引的事实。

sentences.en: And this is sort of interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有意思。

sentences.en: This is a state, Pennsylvania, that is on top of the list for places that Trump is focused on because of what happened in 2020, because he lost so narrowly.
sentences.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州是特朗普关注的重点州之首，因为2020年发生的事情，因为他输得太惨了。

sentences.en: And he wants allies in that kind of a state.
sentences.zh: 他想要在这样的州有盟友。

sentences.en: And he thinks that Oz is the person who can be his ally.
sentences.zh: 他认为奥兹就是那个能成为他盟友的人。

sentences.en: And President Trump endorsed Dr. Oz for Senate because Trump knows who the—
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统背书奥兹医生竞选参议员，因为特朗普知道谁是——

sentences.en: Of course, Oz immediately turned Trump's endorsement into television ads and is pushing back on those Hollywood star ads that have been airing so often in recent months,
sentences.zh: 当然，奥兹立即将特朗普的背书变成了电视广告，并反击了近几个月来频繁播出的那些“好莱坞明星”广告，

sentences.en: now saying, sure, you might have seen that, but I'm standing with him now.
sentences.zh: 现在说，当然，你可能看过那个，但我现在和他站在一起。

sentences.en: Trump calls Oz smart, tough, and someone who will never let us down.
sentences.zh: 特朗普称奥兹聪明、强硬，是一个永远不会让我们失望的人。

sentences.en: Endorsed by Trump, the conservative fighter Pennsylvania needs.
sentences.zh: 特朗普背书，宾夕法尼亚州需要的保守派斗士。

sentences.en: So Dr. Oz is a perfect Trump candidate, you're saying, because essentially he's moderate, and in many ways he's a political unknown.
sentences.zh: 所以你说奥兹医生是完美的特朗普候选人，因为本质上他是温和派，而且在很多方面他是一个政治上的未知数。

sentences.en: And so in that sense, Trump's endorsement can help him convince skeptical Republican primary voters by saying, this guy's for real.
sentences.zh: 所以从这个意义上说，特朗普的背书可以帮助他说服持怀疑态度的共和党初选选民，说，这家伙是认真的。

sentences.en: He's my guy.
sentences.zh: 他是我的心腹。

sentences.en: You can trust him.
sentences.zh: 你可以信任他。

sentences.en: And then, because Oz is seen as such a moderate, he can then go on, Trump thinks, to win in the general election because he's not seen as too far right for, say,
sentences.zh: 然后，因为奥兹被视为如此温和，特朗普认为他可以继续赢得大选，因为他不会被认为对，比如说，

sentences.en: a suburban Pennsylvania voter who perhaps watched Oz on TV.
sentences.zh: 一个可能在电视上看过奥兹的宾夕法尼亚州郊区选民来说太右倾了。

sentences.en: Yeah, think about his room for growth, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，想想他的增长空间，对吧？

sentences.en: What is his ceiling?
sentences.zh: 他的上限是多少？

sentences.en: His ceiling with Trump's endorsement is going to be higher, right?
sentences.zh: 有了特朗普的背书，他的上限会更高，对吧？

sentences.en: If you pick, if he endorses in some race the Trumpiest candidate already, those voters are already going to know that Trump supports them.
sentences.zh: 如果你选择，如果他在某场竞选中背书了已经最“特朗普”的候选人，那些选民已经会知道特朗普支持他们。

sentences.en: If he endorses someone else, they have a lot more room to grow.
sentences.zh: 如果他背书了其他人，他们就有更多的增长空间。

sentences.en: The flip side of that is the sort of MAGA base of the Republican Party is like, excuse me, this isn't our kind of a candidate.
sentences.zh: 反过来说，共和党内所谓的MAGA基础选民会说，不好意思，这不是我们那种候选人。

sentences.en: And so it puts Trump in a place of, can he push and define Republicanism to be allied with Trump regardless of some of your other politics?
sentences.zh: 所以这让特朗普处于一个位置，他能否推动并定义共和党主义，使其与特朗普结盟，而不考虑你其他的一些政治立场？

sentences.en: Okay, Shane, what about Ohio?
sentences.zh: 好的，肖恩，俄亥俄州呢？

sentences.en: Talk about the endorsement there.
sentences.zh: 谈谈那里的背书。

sentences.en: Well, let's start with that scene at Mar-a-Lago where you have multiple candidates vying for Trump's approval in front of Trump.
sentences.zh: 嗯，让我们从海湖庄园的那一幕开始，多名候选人在特朗普面前争夺他的认可。

sentences.en: Okay, none of them actually got his approval.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他们中没有一个人真正得到了他的认可。

sentences.en: The approval actually went, the endorsement has gone to someone else entirely.
sentences.zh: 认可实际上去了，背书已经给了完全不同的人。

sentences.en: He loves Ohio and he, frankly, he's a great Buckeye.
sentences.zh: 他热爱俄亥俄州，而且坦率地说，他是一个伟大的七叶树人。

sentences.en: So what I'd like to do is ask J.D.
sentences.zh: 所以我想要做的是请J.D.

sentences.en: Vance.
sentences.zh: 万斯。

sentences.en: A candidate named J.D.
sentences.zh: 一位名叫J.D.

sentences.en: Vance.
sentences.zh: 万斯的候选人。

sentences.en: Come forward.
sentences.zh: 上前来。

sentences.en: I want to pick somebody that's going to win.
sentences.zh: 我想选一个能赢的人。

sentences.en: And this man is going to win.
sentences.zh: 而这个人会赢。

sentences.en: Come on up, J.D.
sentences.zh: 上来吧，J.D.

sentences.en: And Vance actually has some parallels to Dr. Oz because Vance is a little bit famous.
sentences.zh: 万斯实际上和奥兹医生有一些相似之处，因为万斯有点出名。

sentences.en: Now, he's not television famous, but he wrote a book, Hillbilly Elegy, right after the 2016 campaign.
sentences.zh: 现在，他不是电视明星，但他写了一本书，《乡下人的悲歌》，就在2016年竞选之后。

sentences.en: I read it.
sentences.zh: 我读过它。

sentences.en: That became kind of this manual for a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 那本书成了很多人的手册。

sentences.en: What did happen in the 2016 campaign?
sentences.zh: 2016年竞选中到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: But Vance was not exactly a pro-Trump person at the time.
sentences.zh: 但万斯当时并不是一个亲特朗普的人。

sentences.en: In fact, he was pretty much the opposite.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他几乎完全相反。

sentences.en: I'm a never-Trump guy.
sentences.zh: 我是一个反特朗普的人。

sentences.en: I never liked him.
sentences.zh: 我从来不喜欢他。

sentences.en: In 2016, he used the words never-Trump to describe himself.
sentences.zh: 2016年，他用“反特朗普”这个词来形容自己。

sentences.en: So my dad is a Trump supporter.
sentences.zh: 所以我爸爸是特朗普的支持者。

sentences.en: And I love my dad.
sentences.zh: 我爱我爸爸。

sentences.en: And I always say, Dad, you know, Trump is not going to actually make any of these problems better.
sentences.zh: 我总是说，爸爸，你知道，特朗普实际上不会让这些问题中的任何一个变得更好。

sentences.en: How does that guy get the Trump Republican primary endorsement?
sentences.zh: 那个人是怎么获得特朗普共和党初选背书的？

sentences.en: Well, he did one of the things that Trump likes most, which is he flipped.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他做了特朗普最喜欢的事情之一，那就是他倒戈了。

sentences.en: I asked folks not to judge me based on what I said in 2016, because I've been very open about the fact that I did say those critical things, and I regret them.
sentences.zh: 我请大家不要根据我在2016年所说的话来评判我，因为我一直很坦诚地承认我确实说了那些批评的话，我对此感到后悔。

sentences.en: And I regret being wrong about the guy.
sentences.zh: 我后悔当时看错了那个人。

sentences.en: I think that he was a good president.
sentences.zh: 我认为他是一位好总统。

sentences.en: He went on Fox News in 2021, and he said he regretted some of his past statements about Trump.
sentences.zh: 他在2021年上了福克斯新闻，说他后悔过去关于特朗普的一些言论。

sentences.en: I've taken a lot of flack myself over the last few years for standing up for the president's voters, but also standing up for the agenda.
sentences.zh: 过去几年，我自己因为支持总统的选民，但也因为支持他的议程，而受到了很多抨击。

sentences.en: He said, I'm now a Trump Republican.
sentences.zh: 他说，我现在是一名特朗普共和党人。

sentences.en: And he did it publicly, and he did it privately.
sentences.zh: 他公开这样做了，私下也这样做了。

sentences.en: He went and he had a meeting with Trump, too.
sentences.zh: 他也去见了特朗普。

sentences.en: And he moved beyond what he had said before and said he was with him now that he had been wrong.
sentences.zh: 他超越了之前所说的话，并表示既然他错了，他现在支持他。

sentences.en: That is meaningful to Trump.
sentences.zh: 这对特朗普来说很有意义。

sentences.en: He likes the idea of people who are once against him who he flipped.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢那些曾经反对他但后来被他策反的人。

sentences.en: It shows his power.
sentences.zh: 这显示了他的力量。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Okay, so what lesson do we think can be drawn from the endorsements that we've seen so far from Trump, especially the Vance-Oz endorsements?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么我们认为从特朗普迄今为止的背书，特别是万斯和奥兹的背书，可以吸取什么教训？

sentences.en: Well, there's definitely not a broader formula on ideology that applies across its endorsements.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在意识形态上肯定没有一个适用于所有背书的更广泛的公式。

sentences.en: To the extent that there is a lesson, it really is, are you loyal?
sentences.zh: 如果说有什么教训的话，那就是：你忠诚吗？

sentences.en: And we talked about this earlier.
sentences.zh: 我们之前讨论过这一点。

sentences.en: You know, he's emerged as this sort of party boss figure.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他已经成为了这种政党老板式的人物。

sentences.en: And if you're running a political machine, what do you need most?
sentences.zh: 如果你在经营一台政治机器，你最需要什么？

sentences.en: You need loyal soldiers in your machine.
sentences.zh: 你需要机器里有忠诚的士兵。

sentences.en: And there's a specific thing he's been looking for loyalty on.
sentences.zh: 而且他一直在寻找某种特定的忠诚。

sentences.en: It's, will you repeat the fact that he believes the 2020 election falsely was stolen?
sentences.zh: 那就是，你是否愿意重复他那套关于2020年大选被窃取的虚假信念？

sentences.en: And in race after race, that's the thing he says out loud that he's looking at?
sentences.zh: 在一场又一场的竞选中，这难道不是他公开宣称自己在寻找的东西吗？

sentences.en: It's where he's issued anti-endorsements, where he said, I haven't picked a candidate in this race, but don't vote for the guy who was against me on the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 他发布“反背书”的地方，就是他说：“我还没在这场竞选中选定候选人，但别投给那个在2020年大选问题上反对我的人。”

sentences.en: Where did he do that?
sentences.zh: 他在哪里这样做过？

sentences.en: He's done that in Arizona, where he has not picked a candidate for Senate yet.
sentences.zh: 他在亚利桑那州这样做过，那里他还没有选定参议院候选人。

sentences.en: But he did say, don't vote for this guy because he wasn't with me sufficiently.
sentences.zh: 但他确实说过，别投给这家伙，因为他对我支持得不够。

sentences.en: He did an anti-endorsement, sort of a conditional anti-endorsement, even more complicated, in Alaska,
sentences.zh: 他在阿拉斯加州做了一次反背书，或者说是一种有条件的“反背书”，情况更复杂，

sentences.en: where he said, I'm going to endorse the governor of Alaska so long as he doesn't endorse the incumbent Republican senator from Alaska,
sentences.zh: 他说：“只要阿拉斯加州长不支持该州的现任共和党参议员，我就支持他，

sentences.en: Lisa Murkowski, because she voted for his impeachment.
sentences.zh: 也就是丽莎·穆尔科斯基，因为她投票支持弹劾我。”

sentences.en: And sure enough, the Republican governor of Alaska said,
sentences.zh: 果然，阿拉斯加州的共和党州长说：

sentences.en: OK, I'm not endorsing Murkowski.
sentences.zh: “好吧，我不支持穆尔科斯基。”

sentences.en: And Trump's conditional endorsement sort of went into effect.
sentences.zh: 于是特朗普的有条件背书算是生效了。

sentences.en: So beside the ability to immediately tell the world that you're a Trump Republican, what do these endorsements from Trump in 2022 actually come with?
sentences.zh: 所以，除了能立刻向全世界宣告你是“特朗普派共和党人”之外，特朗普在2022年的这些背书到底有什么实际价值？

sentences.en: Well, not a lot.
sentences.zh: 嗯，没多少。

sentences.en: It comes with a $5,000 check in most cases and a written statement that Trump has issued.
sentences.zh: 大多数情况下，它只附带一张5000美元的支票和特朗普发布的一份书面声明。

sentences.en: And, you know, you're just supposed to do with that what you can.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你只能拿着这些东西尽力而为。

sentences.en: And so even though you're getting, in some ways, so little, that little bit you're getting, the Trump seal of approval, is worth all this fight
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管在某些方面你得到的很少，但你得到的那一点点东西——特朗普的认可印章——却值得为此进行所有这些斗争，

sentences.en: because in some ways that's just almost everything.
sentences.zh: 因为在某种程度上，这几乎就是一切。

sentences.en: It's a shield.
sentences.zh: 它是一面盾牌。

sentences.en: It's a weapon.
sentences.zh: 它是一件武器。

sentences.en: It is the way that these candidates are differentiating themselves and saying to voters, you can trust me because he trusts me.
sentences.zh: 这是这些候选人将自己与他人区分开来的方式，他们对选民说：你可以信任我，因为他信任我。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Shane, you started to hint that the Trump endorsement has been meaningful for Dr. Oz and for J.D.
sentences.zh: 肖恩，你刚才暗示特朗普的背书对奥兹医生和J.D.

sentences.en: Vance in these two closely watched Republican Senate primary races that are coming up.
sentences.zh: 万斯在接下来这两场备受关注的共和党参议员初选中很有意义。

sentences.en: But I'm curious, though, as we zoom way out to the question of whether Trump's endorsement
sentences.zh: 但我很好奇，当我们放眼全局，去探讨特朗普的背书

sentences.en: is working in the 2022 midterms, what is the overall effect so far of a Trump endorsement?
sentences.zh: 在2022年中期选举中是否奏效时，特朗普背书的总体效果如何？

sentences.en: Well, it's important to know that that's just two of more than 150 endorsements that he's made.
sentences.zh: 嗯，要知道，这只是他做出的150多次背书中的两次。

sentences.en: And we're going to find out a lot more in the coming weeks as we have a series of primaries that are going to test his power.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，我们将通过一系列初选来检验他的影响力，届时我们会了解更多。

sentences.en: But so far, some of the people he's backed haven't surged at all.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，他支持的一些人并没有出现任何支持率激增。

sentences.en: I think the most important one, one of the ones he's most been focused on, is the Georgia governor's race, which is later in May.
sentences.zh: 我认为最重要的一场，也是他最关注的竞选之一，是佐治亚州的州长竞选，那是在5月下旬。

sentences.en: And he personally recruited David Perdue, a former senator, to run against the incumbent Republican, Brian Kemp.
sentences.zh: 他亲自招募了前参议员大卫·珀杜，去挑战现任共和党州长布莱恩·肯普。

sentences.en: And this race, like so many others, comes back to the 2020 election lie because Kemp certified the election.
sentences.zh: 这场竞选和许多其他竞选一样，又回到了2020年大选的谎言上，因为肯普认证了那次选举结果。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Trump is still angry at him over it.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普至今仍为此对他耿耿于怀。

sentences.en: But Trump's endorsement alone has not been enough to lift Perdue, who polling shows is pretty far behind Kemp still.
sentences.zh: 但仅凭特朗普的背书还不足以提振珀杜，民调显示他目前仍远远落后于肯普。

sentences.en: Shane, it feels like in some ways, the right question at the end of this primary cycle is not going to be how many candidates that Trump endorsed win, right?
sentences.zh: 肖恩，感觉在某种程度上，这个初选周期结束时，真正的问题不在于特朗普背书的候选人赢了多少，对吧？

sentences.en: Because in a sense, these primaries, everything you have described, reveals that almost everyone involved has in one way or another
sentences.zh: 因为从某种意义上说，这些初选，以及你所描述的一切，揭示了几乎所有参与者都在以某种方式

sentences.en: transformed themselves into the kind of candidate that Trump might endorse.
sentences.zh: 将自己改造成特朗普可能会背书的那种候选人。

sentences.en: And therefore, the winner will inevitably be, in a lot of these cases, some form of a Trump candidate, even if they didn't start that way in their political career.
sentences.zh: 因此，在很多情况下，赢家不可避免地会成为某种形式的“特朗普候选人”，即使他们政治生涯的起点并非如此。

sentences.en: And that feels like the real power of this party boss machine that you have been reporting on.
sentences.zh: 这感觉才是你一直在报道的这个党魁机器的真正力量所在。

sentences.en: It's this gravitational pull for the entire Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 这是整个共和党的引力场。

sentences.en: And the story of Trump's power,
sentences.zh: 而关于特朗普权力的故事，

sentences.en: it's partly how he exercises it.
sentences.zh: 部分在于他如何行使权力。

sentences.en: It's partly what he's doing and the endorsements he's making.
sentences.zh: 部分在于他正在做什么以及他做出的背书。

sentences.en: But I think the bigger story is told through the actions of everyone else.
sentences.zh: 但我认为更大的故事是通过其他所有人的行为来讲述的。

sentences.en: It's through the centralness of Mar-a-Lago, through the fact that senators and governors and House members
sentences.zh: 是通过海湖庄园的中心地位，通过参议员、州长、众议员，

sentences.en: and ambitions for Republicans of all stripes are flying down there to meet with him, to make their case and to pledge their loyalty.
sentences.zh: 以及各色共和党人的野心，他们飞往那里去见他，去陈述自己的立场并宣誓效忠。

sentences.en: And in all of those ways, he's really already won.
sentences.zh: 从所有这些方面来看，他其实已经赢了。

sentences.en: But, and this is a big but, these are just primaries, right?
sentences.zh: 但是——这是一个很大的“但是”——这些只是初选，对吧？

sentences.en: And in a primary, you face the party faithful.
sentences.zh: 在初选中，你面对的是党内忠实拥护者。

sentences.en: You face the base.
sentences.zh: 你面对的是基本盘。

sentences.en: But at the end of the primary, all these candidates end up having to face regular voters in a general election.
sentences.zh: 但在初选结束后，所有这些候选人最终都必须在普选中面对普通选民。

sentences.en: Independents and Democrats, many of whom we know from polling, have a pretty dim view of Donald Trump and his claims of election fraud.
sentences.zh: 独立选民和民主党人，我们从民调中得知，他们中的许多人对唐纳德·特朗普及其关于选举舞弊的说法评价相当低。

sentences.en: So doesn't his endorsement and the things that these candidates, the Vance's and the Oz's, have had to do to get it, doesn't that end up becoming a pretty big liability
sentences.zh: 那么，他的背书，以及这些候选人——万斯和奥兹们——为了得到背书而必须做的事情，难道不会最终成为一个巨大的负担吗？

sentences.en: for a general election voter this fall, in the election that really matters?
sentences.zh: 对于今年秋天普选中的选民来说，在真正重要的选举中？

sentences.en: I mean, this is the box for the Republican Party in the Trump era.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是特朗普时代共和党所面临的困境。

sentences.en: Donald Trump and being allied with him is the surest way to win a Republican primary.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普以及与他结盟是赢得共和党初选最稳妥的方式。

sentences.en: But Republicans who are allied with Trump were losing, including Trump himself, throughout his presidency.
sentences.zh: 但与特朗普结盟的共和党人，包括特朗普本人，在他的总统任期内一直在输。

sentences.en: In four years, Republicans lost the House, the Senate, and the White House while allied with Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 四年里，共和党在与唐纳德·特朗普结盟的同时，失去了众议院、参议院和白宫。

sentences.en: And that's what makes his staying on the political scene so remarkable.
sentences.zh: 而这正是他留在政治舞台上显得如此非同寻常的原因。

sentences.en: It's not just that he's a former president exerting all this power in politics.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是因为他是一位在前政治领域行使权力的前总统。

sentences.en: It's that he's a former president who oversaw massive losses for his party, and the party remains adhered to him.
sentences.zh: 而是因为他是一位曾目睹本党惨败的前总统，而该党依然对他死心塌地。

sentences.en: And that fact is, frankly, one of the things that gives Democrats some hope in 2022.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，这一事实是让民主党人在2022年看到希望的原因之一。

sentences.en: In a year in which Joe Biden's approval rating is dim to around 40%, in which gas prices are going up and inflation is going up,
sentences.zh: 在这一年里，乔·拜登的支持率低至40%左右，汽油价格在上涨，通货膨胀也在加剧，

sentences.en: you know, Democrats, they have passed some significant bills, but the public isn't talking about them.
sentences.zh: 你知道，民主党人确实通过了一些重要的法案，但公众并不在谈论它们。

sentences.en: And so, look, if you don't have a lot to run on, you run against someone else.
sentences.zh: 所以，听着，如果你没有什么政绩可供竞选，你就去攻击对手。

sentences.en: And in Trump, they think they have someone who they can run against because they've done it before with some success.
sentences.zh: 而在特朗普身上，他们认为自己找到了一个可以攻击的对象，因为他们以前这样做过，并且取得了一些成功。

sentences.en: Because it gives the Democrats a pretty straightforward message.
sentences.zh: 因为它给了民主党一个相当直接的信息。

sentences.en: They can simply run as, you're still the party of Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们可以简单地竞选说：你们仍然是特朗普的政党。

sentences.en: You're still the party that stands by this guy who lost, who was involved in January 6th, who has been kicked off every major social media platform.
sentences.zh: 你们仍然是那个支持这个失败者、参与了1月6日事件、被所有主流社交媒体平台封杀的人的政党。

sentences.en: They can run Democrats against Trump versus a big comprehensive set of ideas.
sentences.zh: 他们可以让民主党人对抗特朗普，而不是对抗一套宏大的综合理念。

sentences.en: Possibly.
sentences.zh: 有可能。

sentences.en: The issue is that midterms are almost always a referendum on the party in power, and it's Democrats who are in power now.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，中期选举几乎总是对执政党的公投，而现在执政的是民主党。

sentences.en: But Democratic strategists see that possibility of running against Trump as maybe one of the best arguments they'll have this fall.
sentences.zh: 但民主党策略师认为，这种对抗特朗普的可能性，也许是他们今年秋天能拥有的最好论点之一。

sentences.en: And Republican strategists are worried about that too.
sentences.zh: 共和党策略师也对此感到担忧。

sentences.en: Because in a year in which you want voters to be thinking about Democratic failures when you go to vote this fall, the possibility of Trump being out there
sentences.zh: 因为在这一年里，当你希望选民在今年秋天投票时考虑民主党的失败时，特朗普出现在那里的可能性

sentences.en: means that voters might be thinking about him instead.
sentences.zh: 意味着选民可能会转而考虑他。

sentences.en: And if you have a choice in your Republican campaign, you want voters thinking right now about Joe Biden and you don't want voters thinking about Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 如果你在共和党竞选中可以选择，你现在希望选民考虑的是乔·拜登，而不是唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: Well, Shane, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，肖恩，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间去深入了解付费墙背后的内容，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Monday night,
sentences.zh: 周一晚上，

sentences.en: Politico reported that the Supreme Court has privately voted to strike down Roe v.
sentences.zh: Politico报道称，最高法院已私下投票决定推翻罗诉韦德案，

sentences.en: Wade, the landmark decision that has guaranteed the right to an abortion for nearly a half century.
sentences.zh: 这一具有里程碑意义的裁决在近半个世纪里保障了堕胎权。

sentences.en: Politico said it had obtained a draft opinion written by Justice Samuel Alito in February in which the court's conservative majority ruled that Roe was wrongly decided
sentences.zh: Politico称其获得了一份由大法官塞缪尔·阿利托在2月撰写的意见草案，其中法院的保守派多数派裁定罗诉韦德案的判决是错误的，

sentences.en: and that abortion should be left to elected officials, not the courts.
sentences.zh: 并认为堕胎问题应留给民选官员，而不是法院。

sentences.en: In the draft,
sentences.zh: 在草案中，

sentences.en: Alito wrote,
sentences.zh: 阿利托写道，

sentences.en: If the Supreme Court issues a ruling similar to the leaked draft, each state would decide for itself whether to allow or restrict abortion, and many Republican-controlled states
sentences.zh: 如果最高法院发布了类似于泄露草案的裁决，每个州将自行决定是否允许或限制堕胎，而许多由共和党控制的州

sentences.en: would be expected to severely restrict it.
sentences.zh: 预计将严格限制堕胎。

sentences.en: Politico did not identify the source of the leaked opinion.
sentences.zh: Politico没有透露泄露意见书的来源。

sentences.en: On Monday night, the Supreme Court declined to comment on its report but did not deny the legitimacy of the opinion.
sentences.zh: 周一晚上，最高法院拒绝就该报道发表评论，但并未否认该意见书的真实性。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer,
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一台受到严格控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天，

sentences.en: when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该党就陷入了一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。
